question.worked_solution:
The formula for the derivative of the inverse hyperbolic cotangent function is

$$
\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x)=\frac{1}{1-{x}^{2}}.
$$

Using the formula above with the chain rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{arcoth}⁡(3x-1)) \\  & =\frac{1}{1-(3x-1)^{2}}\cdot (3x-1)^{′} \\  & =\frac{1}{1-(1-6x+9{x}^{2})}\cdot (3) \\  & =\frac{3}{6x-9{x}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{3}{3x(2-3x)} \\  & =\frac{1}{x(2-3x)}.\end{aligned}
$$
